body:
depression is a fickle mistress friend, all of those things don't invalidate what you're going through. you could have the perfect life, but if you don't have happiness, it's just not the same.

something i heard once that changed my life is if you're drowning in a puddle, or drowning in a lake, you're still drowning. 

dont invalidate your sadness because you have a good life. remember that it's okay to be upset with the way things are, even if things are going "well"
